relations: The macro frame's static iris and fixed lashes persist, confining all motion to the pupil's internal reflection.
The left white-coated figure resolves from a vertical smear into a solid form with leg shapes and a bright point.
The figure's raised arm pivots toward the child, who rotates from a frontal stance to a left-facing profile.
The right reddish text remains in place but softens, while the surrounding radial glow brightens around the figures.
caption: An extreme macro close-up holds a single human eye open and unblinking, framed by reddish-brown skin, a dark brow, and dense fixed lashes. The gray-blue iris does not shift; all motion is confined to the scene reflected within the pupil. There, a child in a mustard-yellow sweater stands centered before a bright radial glow, while to the left a pale white-coated figure resolves from a faint vertical smear into a clearer form with two leg shapes and a small bright point of light near its top. As the clip progresses, the white figure grows more solid relative to its start, and its raised arm carrying the bright point pivots toward the child. The child rotates from a more frontal stance toward a left-facing profile oriented toward the figure, a change of pose rather than translation. Faint reddish graffiti-like text on the right stays in place, softening slightly, while the surrounding glow brightens around the figure.
